claim: For the unit-circumradius Euclidean regular hexagon in a fixed orientation relative to the square lattice, the exact translative covering radius is the maximum of two explicit trigonometric expressions, with a unique cusp minimum modulo reflection and hexagonal/square symmetries.
integrity: Analytic proof and deterministic numerical diagnostics checked in the complete package. No independent mathematical audit, formal proof certification, or historical completeness guarantee.
scientific_limitations: Square integer lattice and rigid regular Euclidean hexagon only; no statement about arbitrary lattices or other polygon shapes. The known uniform-in-rotation maximum is not claimed new. Historical priority under equivalent normed-plane Voronoi descriptions is not guaranteed.
title: Orientation-resolved lattice covering radius of the regular hexagon and its symmetry-breaking optimum
